n: 8 Port Fast Ethernet Smart POE Switch - High power 110W.
d: HIKVISION 8 Port Fast 10/100Mbps Ethernet Smart POE Switch - High power 110W

specs.label: Ports
specs.value: 8 × 10/100 Mbps PoE port,1 × Gigabit RJ45 port

specs.label: Packet Forwarding Rate
specs.value: Whole-Device Performance: 4.17 Mpps Port Performance: 2.68 Mpps

specs.label: Switching Capacity
specs.value: Whole-Device Performance: 5.6 Gbps Port Performance: 3.6 Gbps

specs.label: Long Range
specs.value: Ports 1 to 8: up to 300 m. Long range performance may vary depend on camera model or cable condition.

specs.label: Port Isolation
specs.value: Ports 1 to 8: port isolation mode to improve network security Ports in an isolation group cannot communicate with each other, but they can communicate with ports outside the isolation group.

specs.label: PoE Watchdog
specs.value: Ports 1 to 8: auto detect and restart the cameras that do not respond.

specs.label: Loop Prevention
specs.value: Loop prevention is used to prevent the switching network from forming loops, which will seriously affect network communication. Disabled by default.
